comment: SBFIN-4 check_encoding known failures. SHRINK-ONLY: max_entries is pinned at creation and may never rise; the checker fails in code if entries exceed it, if an entry lacks an owner, or if a listed entry NO LONGER fails (remove it). That last rule is why this file is safe here: the decoders were fixed at their sites in this commit, but the artifact still carries the bad name because no pipeline has run. The moment the elections chain re-runs, this entry stops failing and the checker DEMANDS its removal — the re-run cannot quietly leave the pin standing.

entries.note: 0x92 (cp1252 right single quote) read as latin-1 -> U+0092. Decoders fixed at ingest_ie.py and enrich_committee_names.py in the same commit; the artifact predates the fix. Urban Center Action's joint-top funder at 19.3%, live on the deployed elections tool.
